jobs.title: Manager, Clinical Operations
jobs.location: United States · Remote (Eastern Time business hours)
jobs.why: Healthcare operations role centered on building scalable care-delivery workflows, launch infrastructure, documentation, tooling, enrollment operations and cross-team execution. Kevin’s ABA operations, intake, training, workflow design and systems/process work map closely.
jobs.gap: The role is framed for a highly capable operator in a scaling oncology-care model; Kevin should emphasize healthcare operations ownership and implementation experience while acknowledging he has not worked specifically in oncology/value-based care.

jobs.title: Digital Program Manager
jobs.why: Healthcare-tech program role covering client onboarding, implementation, project tracking, reporting, data validation, documentation, training and cross-functional work with Product, Engineering, Analytics and Operations. This is a strong bridge from Kevin’s healthcare operations and systems/project work.
jobs.gap: Datavant prefers 3–6 years in operations/project management/client success and exposure to digital healthcare workflows. Kevin should position his systems implementations and healthcare operations clearly without overstating technical data skills.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.why: Healthcare software role owning CRM/marketing automation, attribution, reporting, integrations, AI-enabled workflows and funnel operations. Kevin’s marketing background plus workflow automation, reporting and systems experience makes this a strong Growth Operations fit; SEO is only a supporting component.
jobs.gap: Prompt asks for 5+ years specifically in marketing operations and deep hands-on HubSpot ownership. Kevin should emphasize transferable CRM/automation experience and avoid implying platform depth he does not have.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.why: Healthcare business-operations role requiring project delivery, process discipline, cross-functional coordination and enterprise/healthcare experience. Kevin’s healthcare operations plus systems/project-management work align well with the role’s core execution needs.
jobs.gap: Formal PMP/CAPM and deeper enterprise project-management methodology are preferred. Kevin should foreground hands-on project ownership and workflow improvements rather than claim certifications he does not hold.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.location: Troy, MI · On-site / travel up to 35%
jobs.why: Healthtech implementation role owning project plans, client relationships, cross-functional workstreams, risks, testing, documentation and operational handoff. Kevin’s systems implementation, healthcare operations, training and stakeholder coordination are relevant.
jobs.gap: This is a reach because it requires direct health-plan implementation and claims experience plus 5+ years in healthcare implementation/project management; it is also Michigan-based and travel-heavy.

jobs.title: Medical Practice Operations Manager - Primary Care
jobs.why: Direct healthcare operations role covering staffing, workflow, compliance, credentialing, patient experience and administrative operations. Kevin’s ABA healthcare operations, recruiting/training, intake and credentialing-process experience transfer well.
jobs.gap: The posting asks for 8–10+ years of medical-practice management plus substantial revenue-cycle, billing and insurance expertise, making this a significant seniority/domain stretch.
